description: Pure style facts from P1 AtomicTextObservation. Font/size/flags/bold/italic/superscript + style_signature + comparison. NO semantic classification (no is_heading/is_title/is_body/is_caption/region_type).
design_principles: P3 produces only style facts, not interpretations.
bold/italic from flags BITS (authoritative), not font-name guessing.
underline/subscript null where PyMuPDF 1.26.5 does not reliably encode.
